title.narrative: High level visits and and increase in cross-country collaboration have enabled UNICEF to gain attention from further afield and amplify Pacific youth voices globally. Our main focuses for the year included violence against children, climate and youth engagement. An increased focus on media engagement and capacity building around the region has resulted in an increase in the number of media hits, while the implementation of UNICEF Pacific’s Digital Communication Strategy continued in 2024, showed continued growth recorded across all channels.
